title: Local perfection of cycle evaluation
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], T,J integer cochain complexes of O_X-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and n an integer. Suppose H^k(J)=0 for k != 0. Let e:H^n(Hom(T,J)) -> Hom(H^(-n)(T),H^0(J)) satisfy the cycle formula of [new-b2-homology-evaluation-definitions]. For an open V of X and an open W of V, write F for the termwise restriction functor of [new-b2-homology-evaluation-definitions]. If F(J) is K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex] and F(T) admits the finite-free zero-differential quasi-isomorphism roof defined in [new-b2-homology-evaluation-definitions], then restriction of e to V and then to W is an isomorphism.
